outroLine: Point it at the mailbox — orders import themselves.

beats.shot: Land on Settings → Email intake (?tab=email deep-link). Cursor settles on the card title, sweeps the 'IMAP polling every 5 minutes' subtitle, rests on the paid-plan notice.
beats.vo: When purchase orders arrive as email attachments, ProcuLink can pick them up itself. It polls a mailbox over IMAP every five minutes and turns the attachments into orders. You set it up here, under Settings, Email intake — and it's included on every paid plan.

beats.shot: Click IMAP host and type imap.nordic-electronics.example, rest on Port (993 stays) and the SSL checkbox.
beats.vo: Connecting is standard IMAP. The host — imap dot gmail dot com for Gmail, or your company's mail server — the port, usually nine nine three, and SSL on, which is how almost every provider ships.

beats.shot: Type the username, then the password (rendered as dots). Glide the helper: 'Gmail and Outlook need an app-specific password, not your normal login.'
beats.vo: Then the mailbox login. One thing matters here: Gmail and Outlook accounts need an app-specific password, generated in the provider's security settings — the normal login won't work. Like every secret in ProcuLink, it's stored encrypted.

beats.shot: Rest on Folder (INBOX stays), then open the Default supplier select and pick ElectroSupply Co.
beats.vo: Point it at a folder — inbox by default, though a dedicated orders folder keeps unrelated mail out of the scan. And pick a default supplier: an email carries no routing of its own, so every imported order is attributed to the supplier you choose here.

beats.shot: Glide the IMAP mailbox helper line — 'unseen messages with CSV, XLSX, or PDF attachments are imported' — then rest on the Save email button (never clicked — saving has no mock backend).
beats.vo: What gets picked up? Unseen messages with CSV, spreadsheet, or PDF attachments — it says so right on the form. Each attachment becomes its own order, and the message is marked as read afterwards, so nothing is ever imported twice.

beats.shot: Glide the footer — 'Passwords are stored encrypted. Last poll: not run yet.' — then rest on the polling toggle (disabled on the Pilot mock plan; never clicked).
beats.vo: After the first run, the time of the last poll shows down here. If orders should be arriving and that time isn't moving, re-check the host and the app password — that's the usual fix. Then switch polling on, and the mailbox takes care of itself.
